name: Goshujin-sama to Tsukaima
source:
This morning, a letter that said "I'll come tonight" was in my mailbox.
Who could have sent it?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/14078]Freem![/url]]
translation:
今天早上，我的邮箱里收到了一封写着“今晚我会来”的信。
谁可以发送它？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/14078]Freem![/url]]
